procedure.method: In this fresh independent critic session, I read the explicitly pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, summarize.py, run_agent.py and five native-evidence manifests, without following their unlisted embedded paths. I verified all 27 supplied input byte sizes/SHA-256 pins and all poster PNG IHDR dimensions. The packet supplies no source_assets and no protected_layouts. I invoked tools.view_image with detail="original" inside functions.exec and emitted each returned image with image(...,"original"). I visually inspected the 15 returned exact poster outputs in five member calls, each awaiting native, usage720, thumbnail320, in packet order M1, M2, M3, M4, M5. All fifteen outputs were inspected before the first transcription judgment, any image score or set-diversity score. There was no contact sheet, OCR, asset revisit, generation, edit, agent spawn, fork, resume or peer-review access. session_id is null; runner thread identity and launch/completion provenance are not claimed. The initial optional Pillow metadata attempt failed before reading the remaining inputs; standard-library PNG parsing then successfully verified metadata. That failure did not affect the successful image viewing.

The tightly grouped row begins violet and continues orange, while the other path is uniformly blue, so the identity of the compared motions is less stable than in the people, plants or pours.

The circles read immediately, but the result remains a generic spacing diagram whose specific connection to different speeds depends heavily on the phrase. This is functional abstraction, below the rubric's resolved-specificity anchor.

hierarchy.location: Title and final blue disk cropped at the lower-right
hierarchy.observation: The reading sequence remains clear through reduction and the exiting disk completes the diagonal visual flow.

typography.observation: The syllable blocks are intact, counters and strokes are clear, and the three word lines are decisively separated. Tight intraword spacing does not erase a syllable.
All three words remain strongly legible. The hard black weight suits the graphic vocabulary, although the treatment is conventional rather than exceptionally specific.

space.location: Left alignment of title and first disk; open upper-right field
space.observation: The title and disk row share a left anchor, while the open field gives the lower diagonal sequence room to spread.

space.location: Successively separated blue disks and bottom-right crop
space.observation: The gaps and final edge crop establish a deliberate progression across the portrait field. Empty space participates in that interval comparison.

image_material.location: Colored disk boundaries and overlap lenses
image_material.observation: The disk contours are clean and the overlapping row produces coherent colored lenses. Fine surface variation remains subordinate to the geometry.
The large forms retain clean silhouettes and separation at small scale; the simple flat construction is resolved without needing a realistic object material.

emotion_control.location: Saturated yellow field with violet/orange and blue disks
emotion_control.observation: The palette communicates energy, but the circles provide little emotional relationship beyond brightness and repetition. The effect is generic graphic exuberance rather than a specific controlled feeling about unequal pace.
The two tracks create motion cues, but they do not build a further tension or connection comparable to the shared ground, roots or contrasting liquid responses in other members.

ai_slop.location: Violet first disk in otherwise orange compact row
ai_slop.observation: The unexplained color change within this row adds a category that has no continuing counterpart. Together with the differently oriented blue sequence, it makes the comparison feel assembled from general circle motifs.
Edges are clean and there is no malformed geometry, but the motif logic remains under-resolved. Clean rendering alone does not raise this dimension to the professional-resolution anchor.

residuals: The disk intervals establish substantive nonglyph rhythm, but direction changes and the isolated violet start weaken the specificity of the pace comparison.
The bright elementary graphic vocabulary remains emotionally generic.

image_material.observation: Refractions, twisting stream edges and discrete droplets coherently sustain the clear-liquid material through the fall and impact.

image_material.location: Amber vessel edge, thin strand and rounded pool at lower-right
image_material.observation: Warm translucency, specular highlights and smooth coils distinguish the amber material from the clear one. Glass rims and both pouring paths remain legible through close inspection.

emotion_control.location: Two liquid responses against the restrained gray background
emotion_control.observation: The contrasting flow behaviors produce tactile curiosity and a measured sense of unequal movement. The subdued field keeps attention on that comparison.
The energetic and restrained endpoints preserve the tension at small scale, without requiring an additional visual metaphor.

ai_slop.location: Glass rims, stream origins and landing zones
ai_slop.observation: Each stream visibly joins a vessel and a landing area. The different material responses are internally coherent, with no floating unrelated objects, pseudo-logos or malformed title fragments.
Droplets belong to the clear impact, and amber highlights follow the strand and pool. Fine decoration is tied to the two materials rather than scattered without a source.

residuals: The visible stream behavior suggests contrasting flow cadence; neither liquid identity nor a numerical speed is observable.
The central sans stack is clear and well fitted, but remains a familiar treatment.

evidence.location: Two people crossing one paved scene; small lower single-line title
evidence.observation: Selective blur versus sharp stillness distinguishes this human photographic concept from all four others. Its diagonal crossing and low horizontal type differ from M5's vertical studio comparison and the three illustrations.

evidence.location: Tight upper-left title with compact disks and spaced diagonal disks
evidence.observation: Flat rhythm-by-spacing differs from M3's adjacent unequal gears despite some shared blue/orange and stacked black type. The corner stack and exiting diagonal path provide a separate spatial organization; its conceptual specificity is the weakest member.

evidence.location: Oversized blue gear cropped lower-left; smaller orange gear upper-right
evidence.observation: Tactile unequal wheels establish a mechanical relation distinct from M2's separated disk paths. Its inset title is compressed by wheel contours, unlike the corner-anchored M2 stack and widely led central M5 stack.

evidence.location: Tall/short plants with root bridge and brush-like title
evidence.observation: Connected growth is a distinct organic relationship. The leafy left silhouette, fine lower roots and warm single-line lettering distinguish its material, type and arrangement from every other member.

evidence.location: Clear splash and amber strand flanking centered words
evidence.observation: Material-flow contrast and two vertical pours differ from M1's human motion photograph and all illustrative comparisons. Centered words with wide line leading and contrasting pools produce another type/space structure.

residuals: M2, M3 and M5 reuse a similar heavy black sans vocabulary and one-word-per-line arrangement. Their placement, leading, subject relationships and spatial organization still distinguish them; this is a strong set rather than exceptional diversity.
M2's generic disk logic and M3's compressed title junction remain independent image-level weaknesses. Diversity does not cancel these low dimensions.
